integrity: An exact symbolic nine-case proof establishes the infinite assertion. Finite independent integer checks are supporting regression evidence, not a substitute. Equivalent results outside inspected literature may exist.
scientific_limitations: The proof excludes exact positive period two for all distinct prime pairs only. It does not exclude longer periods, prove the existence of any higher-period orbit, or cover prime sets of size three or more. The fixed-point classification is known from earlier work.
title: No positive two-cycles for any two-prime arithmetic subderivative
